Hi Requester, 

Hope your well and apologies for the delay in response. 

Would it be possible to help me know where/how you located this form on the Council's website please? The contact relates to my pre-decessor and the word document has subsequently been replaced via the below online web form -

In terms of timings, once a request is received, we (in conjunction with the Chair) aim to screen requests within 5 working days so that they can be considered as quickly as possible to allow preparations for any agreed item to be included as part of the next available agenda, which in this case would be 1st December.

Best,
James

Dear Requester,

We were able to carry out a quick catalogue search given the details you submitted. We are happy to provide the sortie and frame reference at no charge, if that level of detail is sufficient for your needs.

These have been identified roughly over the area between covering Llandough (near
Penarth) and Leckwith, south-west of Cardiff

Sortie: GEONEX/0133/91, Frames: 0236, 0237 (1991)

If you decide you’d like to order a Scan on Demand image from this reference, we would require you to add the Image Verification Service (https://www.ncap.org/products-services/scan-on-demand-services/scan-on-demand-pricing/image-verification)  to the order, which is more cost-effective than commissioning a full image search and report. This helps ensure that the image you purchase is exactly the one you’re expecting.

Further information on how to submit a Scan on Demand request can be found using the link below:

        *
How to Order Scan on Demand Images | NCAP<https://www.ncap.org/guides/how-to-order-scan-on-demand>

I hope the above helps.

I would also recommend getting in touch with RCAHMW as they have more comprehensive aerial coverage of Wales: https://rcahmw.gov.uk/

Please let us know if you'd like to go ahead with any of them or if you have any further questions.
Kind regards,
Jane

I am researching the history, occupation and title of Great House Farm
(Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth, Vale of Glamorgan, a holding
between Llandough and Leckwith that was the subject of BP Properties
Ltd v Buckler (Court of Appeal, 1987).

I would be grateful for a search of the National Collection of Aerial
Photography for vertical and oblique sorties covering Llandough (near

with particular interest in 1940–1975.

1. Which sorties and frames cover the area (sortie number, date, scale
and frame numbers), including RAF, Air Ministry and Ordnance Survey
cover held by NCAP.

is of most interest.
